Alright, let me think through this year. I've been working these 10.1 mu for 30 years, so I know the land. My wife and I do most of the field work, and two of the grown kids help on weekends when they're home from the factory. The older ones send money back but they're not around for farming.

I split the land like this: about 8 mu I do wheat-maize double crop — that's the main thing. The other 2.1 mu I put in spring potato, then follow with maize after the potato comes out in late May. So all 10.1 mu gets maize in the summer one way or the other. Potato is partly for the family to eat and partly to sell — potato prices swing around but a good year pays better than grain.

**Wheat (8 mu)** — already planted last October, so right now I'm thinking about spring management. I put down a bag and a half of compound fertilizer (about 40 kg) per mu before planting in the fall. Now in spring, I'll wait until the wheat stands up at jointing and topdress urea — I usually do around 15 kg of urea per mu, which is a bit more than the extension guy says (he usually says 10-12), but I've found my fields respond. If the wheat looks pale I might push it to 20 kg. I'll irrigate at returning-green, at jointing, and once more at heading if it's dry. That's three times usually, sometimes four. Pumping costs money so I watch the weather. Aphids show up most years around heading — I'll spray once, maybe twice if it's bad. Harvest early to mid-June with a hired combine (80 yuan/mu). I'd expect 450-470 kg/mu if it's a normal year.

**Maize (10.1 mu total)** — goes in right after wheat harvest, very tight window, usually within 3-5 days. I use Zhengdan 958 seed or whatever the seed shop has that year, hybrid seed, about 2.5 kg per mu. I don't till — just direct seed into the wheat stubble with a hired planter. At planting I put down compound fertilizer (NPK around 26-10-12 or similar), one bag per mu. Then at the V6-V8 stage (knee-high, about 30-40 days in), I topdress urea, around 10-15 kg per mu. I irrigate once at tasseling if July is dry — usually is. Spray for corn borer once. Harvest late September or early October, by hand mostly because the plots are small and the combine operator skips us. Expect around 450-500 kg/mu.

**Potato (2.1 mu)** — plant in early March when the soil thaws, whole seed potatoes I save from last year plus some new seed I buy. Potato is hungry — I put down more fertilizer than for grain, maybe 50-60 kg compound plus some organic manure from the neighbor's chicken farm if I can get it cheap. Hill up the rows once or twice. Irrigate 3-4 times, potato needs water to size up. Spray for late blight once or twice in April-May. Harvest end of May, before the summer maize window closes. Expect about 1500-1800 kg/mu of potatoes.

Labor-wise, my wife and I handle most days. I'll hire machines (combine, planter) but not much hand labor — we still have enough family hands.
